# veggr

_A PWA that tracks how many different plants you eat each day and each week. 🥦_

</div>

&nbsp;

## Why does this exist?
1. Purely vibe coded — don't blame me for horrible code, I didn't look at it, but it works ;)

## Where to find it

Live at [veggr.webry.com](https://veggr.webry.com).

## How to run it

A Vue 3 + [Vite+](https://viteplus.dev) app (`vp`), installed with pnpm.
1. `pnpm install`
2. `pnpm dev`
3. `pnpm build`
4. `pnpm preview`
5. `pnpm icons` — regenerates the icons via `scripts/gen-icons.mjs`
